proof.text: Exact abelian sections follow from left exactness and the established surjectivity on epimorphisms at the algebraically closed point. The completed coefficient sequence and actual lifted quotient give the principal reduction setup.

Apply the flat-resolution/roof-descent comparison to this setup. The canonical cochain-model comparison identifies its derived sheaf quotient with the prescribed scalarReductionDerivedExtension. Whisker by the integral constructible inclusion.
